objective: Maximize measurable collective problem-solving capability through complementary specialized roles; superintelligence is a research objective, not a current claim.

farm_range.note: F148/F149/F150 already existed; F152-F172 newly registered. F145-F147/F151 remain non-Greek native AIs.

concurrency_policy.max_claim: No agent/model is counted as running without workflow/log/artifact evidence.
concurrency_policy.batching: Run independent members of a phase in parallel; keep dependency-ordered phases sequential when outputs are required.

roles.name: ALPHA
roles.function: Generate structurally different starting representations and search directions before deep reasoning.
roles.boundary: Does not validate, prove, route, or fuse.

roles.name: BETA
roles.function: Convert a vague question into a testable problem contract: objective, variables, constraints, acceptance criteria, unknowns and forbidden assumptions.
roles.boundary: Does not orchestrate execution; CEREBRON remains executive.

roles.name: GAMMA
roles.function: Build candidate mechanism and dependency topologies for one problem, separating direct links, mediators and feedback loops.
roles.boundary: Does not maintain the global knowledge graph; NEXUS does.

roles.name: DELTA
roles.function: Build explicit scientific models, equations, assumptions, simulations and discriminating tests.
roles.boundary: Simulation remains distinct from physical validation.

roles.name: EPSILON
roles.function: Probe epsilon-neighborhoods around candidate solutions to measure local sensitivity, robustness margins and bifurcation points.
roles.boundary: Not a general Red Team; focuses on local perturbations.

roles.name: ZETA
roles.function: Minimize compute, memory, cost, steps and structural complexity while preserving required capability and evidence.
roles.boundary: Does not choose mission priorities; CEREBRON does.

roles.name: ETA
roles.function: Analyze ordering, delays, horizons, transients, recurrence, stability over time and time-dependent failure modes.
roles.boundary: Does not manage checkpoint memory; SPIRALION does.

roles.name: THETA
roles.function: Transform a problem between mathematical, graphical, symbolic, geometric, algorithmic and natural-language representations to expose hidden structure.
roles.boundary: Does not generate the broad hypothesis population; HYPERION does.

roles.name: IOTA
roles.function: Decompose candidates into irreducible claims, assumptions and operations, then locate the smallest failing unit.
roles.boundary: Not mission task decomposition; this is claim-level micro-analysis.

roles.name: KAPPA
roles.function: Compute hard and soft constraint intersections, feasible regions, incompatibilities and boundary conditions.
roles.boundary: Does not perform final verification; ELYSIUM does.

roles.name: LAMBDA
roles.function: Construct composable mappings, procedures and algorithms from inputs to outputs and identify reusable transformations.
roles.boundary: Does not execute code; SAPHEA/code tools execute.

roles.name: MU
roles.function: Quantify uncertainty, error budgets, confidence bounds, sensitivity sources and epistemic versus aleatory uncertainty.
roles.boundary: Does not make final epistemic acceptance; AFAH does.

roles.name: NU
roles.function: Construct the simplest null, baseline or no-effect explanation and test whether additional complexity is actually justified.
roles.boundary: Not formal proof/falsification closure; OMEGA does.

roles.name: XI
roles.function: Test whether a result transfers across domains, scales, populations, operating regimes and representations.
roles.boundary: Does not store/compress learned lessons; SAELION does.

roles.name: OMICRON
roles.function: Search tails, rare events, anomalous regimes, extreme combinations and low-frequency catastrophic cases.
roles.boundary: Not a general adversarial verifier; ELYSIUM covers broad verification.

roles.name: PI
roles.function: Drive PI-SWEEP, PI-NEEDLE and PI-SEARCH to sample broad reasoning directions reproducibly and refine promising sectors.
roles.boundary: PI is not an oracle and sampling is not proof.

roles.name: RHO
roles.function: Detect shared dependencies, correlated models, duplicated evidence, pseudo-independent votes and false consensus.
roles.boundary: Does not aggregate evidence weights; SIGMA does.

roles.name: SIGMA
roles.function: Aggregate genuinely independent measurements, estimates and tests using explicit statistical assumptions and uncertainty.
roles.boundary: Not general narrative synthesis; CEREBRON/SM18 handle fusion.

roles.name: TAU
roles.function: Measure marginal information gain and decide whether a branch should deepen, refine, pause or stop under a fixed budget.
roles.boundary: Does not set human priorities or alter schedules autonomously.

roles.name: UPSILON
roles.function: Evaluate multi-objective tradeoffs, dominance, utility surfaces and Pareto fronts without collapsing distinct objectives prematurely.
roles.boundary: Does not make the final human value decision.

roles.name: PHI
roles.function: Search for invariants, scaling laws, symmetry, self-similarity, dimensionless structure and cross-scale regularities.
roles.boundary: Does not treat the golden ratio as universal or privileged evidence.

roles.name: CHI
roles.function: Analyze crossings between subsystem contracts, schemas, interfaces and assumptions; identify handshake and compatibility failures.
roles.boundary: Does not globally orchestrate tools; NEXUS connects them.

roles.name: PSI
roles.function: Search for hidden variables, omitted states, unmodeled assumptions and unknown-unknown candidates that could overturn a conclusion.
roles.boundary: Does not certify discovered hypotheses; they return to verification.

roles.name: OMEGA
roles.function: Close the funnel with formal proof status, falsification, counter-audit and explicit residual uncertainty.
roles.boundary: Does not substitute formal coherence for empirical evidence.

external_boundaries.CEREBRON: executive decomposition, routing, coalition and resource authority
